ABOUT / SAM ZHIHUAN YANG

Student. Builder.Always curious.

I’m Sam Zhihuan Yang — online, I usually go by sun_rain. I’m a high school student at The Webb Schools, Class of 2028. I build engineering and media projects, lead competition teams, and enjoy video editing and sports.

From Hangzhou, China, to Toronto, Canada, to Los Angeles, US, I’ve learned to find my feet in new places. I’m interested in engineering, entrepreneurship, sports, and telling the stories behind the things I build.
